access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code, suitable equivalent to CASTEP used in the paper.
Standard solid-state pseudopotentials (SSSP) for Mg and Rh in LDA and GGA-WC.

Experimental lattice parameters a=7.905 Å, c=8.256 Å, space group P6₃cm, from Hlukhyy et al., Z. Naturforsch. 59b, 251 (2004). The atomic positions are fully described in the literature; the agent can construct the unit cell.
